roster.name: Chalupa Svébohy
roster.location: Svébohy (Horní Stropnice), Novohradské hory, South Bohemia

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Reigning Retreat Champion
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Let's be completely honest with ourselves: no property in this dataset matches what we already know works at Nový Svět. We offer 14 bedrooms for 30 people—an unheard-of 2.2 people per room ratio with zero crowded 5-bed bunks. We have a dedicated bathroom for every 2 bedrooms, 4 full-size refrigerators so nobody's craft beer or steaks are warm, 4 built-in draft taps, 30+ solid wooden chairs at contiguous tables, massive fabric corner sofas with smart TVs, and a completely acoustically isolated second lounge for 3 AM Werewolf games. Yes, our summer week rate is ~80,000 CZK and we are in Orlické hory—but why trade a battle-tested 10/10 functional layout for an unproven cottage with 2 fridges, 4 bathrooms, and triple-bunks just for a different mountain range?
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 14 bedrooms (2.2 beds/rm) • 4 Fridges • 4 Draft Taps • 6 Bathrooms • Separate Late-Night Game Lounge • 80,000 CZK

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chata U Mazliků
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Top Seed Value & Modernity Challenger
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Nový Svět is iconic, but you are overlooking the massive 50% price discount and modern comfort of Chata U Mazliků in Janov nad Nisou. We deliver 11 spacious bedrooms, 7 full bathrooms (every apartment has its own en-suite facilities!), pristine 9.5/10 Scandinavian renovation, 2 beer taps, and a dedicated lower gym/playroom for board games—all for only 39,900 CZK. You save 40,000 CZK in cash while escaping the Orlické hory valley you've already visited 4 times, discovering fresh Jizerské hory singletracks. Our main table seats 16, but with the adjoining covered veranda and lower lounge, 25 people spread out effortlessly.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 39,900 CZK (50% cheaper than Nový Svět!) • 11 Bedrooms • 7 En-suite Bathrooms • Jizerské hory (Fresh Region) • 9.5/10 Pristine

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Historic Pub & Wellness Contender
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: If you insist on staying in Orlické hory, Tkalcovna crushes Nový Svět on value and wellness. For 48,000 CZK (32,000 CZK less than Nový Svět), you get an authentic historic mill with an integrated private pub room featuring draft beer taps, 25 solid wooden chairs, 6 bathrooms, a Finnish sauna, and an indoor swimming pool that Nový Svět completely lacks. While Nový Svět has more individual double bedrooms (14 vs our 8), our pub atmosphere and wellness facilities make social evenings twice as memorable.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 48,000 CZK (Save 32k) • Integrated Pub with Draft Tap • Indoor Pool + Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • 25 Working Chairs

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chata Termix
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Jeseníky Giant & Workstation King
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Nový Svět claims workstation superiority, but Chata Termix in Kunčice pod Králickým Sněžníkem dominates the entire room on working surface. Our grand dining hall features 45 solid wooden chairs at massive continuous tables where all 30 hackers can work side-by-side with dual monitors without bumping elbows. We feature 10 bedrooms, each with its own private en-suite bathroom (10 bathrooms total—defeating Nový Svět's 6!), a commercial restaurant kitchen with walk-in cold storage and 3 fridges, plus a heated indoor pool for 79,000 CZK. And unlike Nový Svět, we bring the group to the dramatic peaks of Jeseníky.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 45-Chair Grand Workstation Hall • 10 En-suite Bathrooms (100% private) • Heated Indoor Pool • Commercial Gastro Kitchen • Jeseníky

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Statek Vlětice
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Luxury Hackathon & Breakout Champion
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: When it comes to breakout rooms and acoustic separation for board games, Nový Svět cannot compete with our multi-acre farmstead in Central Bohemia. We provide the vaulted brick 'maštal' hall with draft beer tap and giant Chesterfield leather corner sofa, PLUS two separate massive event barns (horní stodola and dolní stodola) and a covered courtyard pergola. You can have full-volume Werewolf in the barn, board games by the fireplace, and deep focus coding in the upper gallery. Yes, we cost 110,000 CZK, but you get hackathon-ready projectors, Finnish sauna, indoor heated pool, and complete secluded privacy just an hour from Prague.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 3 Independent Event Barns & Halls • Giant Leather Lounge Couch • Heated Pool + Sauna • Projector Screen • 1 Hr from Prague

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Statek Tylov
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Jeseník 10/10 Aesthetic & Value Advocate
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Statek Tylov offers a spotless 10.0/10 architectural finish that makes Nový Svět feel like a rustic 90s guesthouse. For 55,000 CZK (25,000 CZK cheaper than Nový Svět), you get 8 beautifully designed Scandinavian bedrooms, 31 comfortable spots, a Finnish sauna, outdoor bathing barrel, a cozy modern fireplace lounge with deep couches and big smart TV, and total peace in Nízký Jeseník. We don't have 14 separate doors, but our sleeping comfort and aesthetic tranquility are world-class.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 55,000 CZK • 10.0/10 Pristine Design • Finnish Sauna + Hot Tub • Deep Designer Couches • Nízký Jeseník

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Lachov 14
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Broumovsko Double-Hall & Bedroom Rival
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: You want 13 bedrooms? Lachov 14 in the Adršpach rock region HAS 13 bedrooms and 50 spots for only 49,000 CZK! We match Nový Svět's bedroom count while beating their price by over 30,000 CZK. More importantly, we have TWO completely independent giant halls on separate floors—the lower dining/work room and the upper multipurpose activity hall. Late-night board games, Werewolf shouting matches, and early morning coffee never overlap. And with 8 bathrooms, our bathroom ratio matches Nový Svět perfectly.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 13 Bedrooms (Matches Nový Svět!) • 49,000 CZK (Save 31k) • 2 Completely Independent Grand Halls • 8 Bathrooms • Adršpach Rocks

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa Měšťan
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Dedicated Game Hall Specialist
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Nový Svět has a nice lounge, but Chalupa Měšťan in Bohdíkov features a dedicated indoor entertainment wing equipped with a tournament pool table, foosball, table tennis, and 20+ padded dining chairs in the newly renovated 2025 kitchen/hall. We have 7 bedrooms with 27 beds, an outdoor pool, and private garden in Jeseníky for 73,788 CZK. We give the board gamers a dedicated game room where tournaments won't disturb anyone sleeping.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: Dedicated Games Wing (Billiards, Foosball, Table Tennis) • Brand-New 2025 Kitchen • Outdoor Pool • Jeseníky

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa Svébohy
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: South Bohemia Natural Haven
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Escape the crowded north and bring the group to Novohradské hory. Svébohy features an idyllic natural swimming biotope pond, Finnish sauna, covered outdoor pergola, and an authentic South Bohemian country farmhouse atmosphere for 70,000 CZK. While our 6 bedrooms require some room sharing, our natural tranquility and outdoor swimming pond blow Nový Svět's lack of water features out of the water.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: Natural Swimming Biotope Pond • Finnish Sauna • South Bohemia / Novohradské hory • Covered Pergola • 70,000 CZK

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa Hříbek
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Krkonoše Premium Timber Lodge
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Nový Svět is functional, but Chalupa Hříbek in Benecko provides authentic Krkonoše alpine luxury. Built with massive Nordic timber (9.0/10 freshness), we feature a luxury outdoor whirlpool, Finnish sauna, covered terrace, and rich wood interiors for 69,930 CZK. If you want high-altitude mountain air and a hot tub under the Krkonoše stars rather than a standard valley house, Hříbek is the true mountain retreat.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: Authentic Nordic Timber • Outdoor Hot Tub + Sauna • Benecko (Krkonoše High Ridge) • 69,930 CZK

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Moravian Wine Cellar & 10-Room Estate
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: If privacy, room count, and separate social spaces matter, Statek U Pepíka in South Moravia (Rašov) delivers 10 bedrooms for 30 people and an authentic private vaulted wine cellar with draft beer and wine taps. We have a dedicated games room with billiards, an indoor fireplace, 5 bathrooms, and a private enclosed courtyard where evening chatter never leaks outside, all for 70,000 CZK (10k cheaper than Nový Svět).
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 10 Bedrooms • Vaulted Wine Cellar • Billiards Games Room • Enclosed Private Courtyard • South Moravia

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa U Medunky
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Central Bohemia Cozy Farmstead
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Only 45 minutes south of Prague near Benešov, Chalupa U Medunky offers 7 bedrooms, 27 beds, a private in-ground pool, and comfortable country seating for 60,000 CZK (20k less than Nový Svět). Avoid the 3-hour Friday drive to the Polish border; start hacking and grilling by 3 PM Friday in a quiet Central Bohemian garden with fast optical Wi-Fi.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 45 Min from Prague • In-ground Pool • 60,000 CZK • Quiet Country Atmosphere • Fast Transit

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Veselá bouda
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Krkonoše High Mountain Lodge
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Veselá bouda in Herlíkovice sits right on the Krkonoše ski ridge with sweeping panoramic views. We offer 8 bedrooms, 31 beds, a large common dining hall seating 25+, an indoor pool, and sauna for 97,230 CZK. If you want true high alpine terrain rather than rolling foothills, our location delivers epic hikes right out the front door.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: High Alpine Ridge Location • Indoor Pool + Sauna • 25+ Seating Hall • Herlíkovice Krkonoše

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Wellness Vila Urban
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Stainless Pool & Wellness Luxury
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Nový Svět has zero pool and zero sauna. Vila Urban in Výprachtice features a heated indoor stainless steel swimming pool with counter-current, a Finnish sauna, and 10/10 pristine modern hotel-grade finish for 79,000 CZK. We provide 7 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms (nearly 1:1 bathroom ratio!), and luxury leather seating. If wellness and modern luxury are your priorities over sheer bedroom count, we are the superior venue in the valley.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: Heated Stainless Indoor Pool (Counter-current) • Finnish Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • 10.0/10 Hotel Finish • 79,000 CZK

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chata Felicita
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Beskydy Timber Mountain Chalet
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Chata Felicita in Ostravice brings the retreat to the majestic Beskydy mountains under Lysá hora. We offer 8 bedrooms, 28 beds, a Finnish sauna, covered grill pergola, and a cozy central timber living hall with plush couches and TV for 88,200 CZK. Escape the north-east entirely and experience the raw beauty of Moravian-Silesian Beskydy.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: Beskydy Mountains (Lysá hora) • Finnish Sauna • Covered Pergola • Cozy Timber Hall

phase_1_opening_pitches.speaker: Chalupa Jindřiška
phase_1_opening_pitches.role: Krkonoše Bar & 10-Room Party Lodge
phase_1_opening_pitches.statement: Chalupa Jindřiška in Strážné features 10 bedrooms, 37 beds, 6 bathrooms, a built-in commercial bar with draft tap, a Finnish sauna, and a dedicated ski-lodge common hall for 70,000 CZK (10,000 CZK less than Nový Svět). We offer 10 separate sleeping spaces and an authentic mountain party pub feel in the heart of Krkonoše.
phase_1_opening_pitches.highlight: 10 Bedrooms • Built-in Commercial Bar with Tap • Finnish Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • Strážné Krkonoše

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Statek Tylov: You boast about your 10.0/10 Scandinavian design, but let's talk real numbers for 30 people: you have only 4 bathrooms! That is nearly 8 grown adults per toilet and shower every single morning before the morning standup. At Nový Svět, we have 6 full bathrooms and 7 WCs distributed right between every two rooms. How can you look 25 hackers in the eye and say a 4-bathroom bottleneck is better than our 1:2 ratio?

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Statek Tylov
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: Our bathrooms are modern designer suites with separate powder rooms, and unlike Nový Svět, we include a pristine Finnish sauna and outdoor hot tub! But if you want to talk bathroom ratios, look at Chata Termix or Chata U Mazliků—they both blow you away on private sanitation while costing less or equal to your 80k.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chata Termix
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Tylov is right, Nový Svět! At Chata Termix, every single one of our 10 bedrooms has its own private en-suite bathroom. That is 10 showers and 10 toilets for 10 rooms—zero morning queues, zero walking down the hall in a towel, and complete individual privacy. You have 6 bathrooms for 14 rooms; we have a perfect 1:1 room-to-bathroom ratio for 79,000 CZK.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Nice try, Termix, but you conveniently omitted bed density! You have 10 rooms for 46 beds—meaning your bedrooms average 4.6 people per room, packed with wooden bunk beds like a youth ski hostel! At Nový Svět, our 14 rooms sleep only 30 people: that is an average of 2.1 people per room! Adults in their late 20s and 30s do not want to sleep on top of each other in quadruple bunk rooms. Our sleep privacy is undeniably superior.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chata U Mazliků
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Hold on, Nový Svět! If you want low bed density AND private bathrooms, look at Chata U Mazliků. We have 11 bedrooms for 31 people (an average of 2.8 beds per room, mostly paired 2-bed double suites), 7 full bathrooms, 9.5/10 brand-new modern freshness, AND our summer rate is 39,900 CZK. You are asking our group to pay FORTY THOUSAND CROWNS MORE just for 3 extra small bedrooms in a region we've already explored 4 times!

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Chata U Mazliků: Here is your fatal flaw: your primary dining table seats only 16 chairs! Where do the remaining 10 to 14 developers sit when everyone opens their laptops at 10 AM? On the floor? At Nový Svět, our primary hall has over 30 solid ergonomic wooden dining chairs with padded cushions along wide contiguous tables. Everyone can plug in their charger, put down a second monitor, and work together in one unified room.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chata U Mazliků
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Nobody sits on the floor! We have 16 chairs at the dining table, 8 chairs on the bright glazed veranda right next to it, and a dedicated lower recreation lounge with tables for 10 more. Real developers actually prefer having quiet breakout zones rather than sitting in one loud 30-person cafeteria where 5 people on Zoom calls drown out the entire room.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Lachov 14
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: If breakout rooms and quiet zones are what you want, Lachov 14 in Broumovsko is the true king. We have 13 bedrooms (matching Nový Svět!), 8 bathrooms, AND TWO completely standalone giant halls on separate floors! You can put 20 laptops in the lower hall and run an intense, screaming Werewolf game with 15 people in the upper hall until 4 AM with thick vaulted walls. At Nový Svět, sound travels up the central wooden staircase directly to the upper bedrooms.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Statek Vlětice
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Lachov 14: You have space, but let's be real about interior comfort: your furniture is dated 90s village hall standard. Where is the relaxation? At Statek Vlětice, we have an enormous black leather Chesterfield corner sofa in front of the open brick fireplace, massive smart TV with sound system, and two entire separate event barns (horní and dolní stodola) plus a covered pergola. Nový Svět has a great couch, but our lounge and event barns provide pure luxury.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Statek Vlětice: You cost 110,000 CZK—30,000 CZK more than us! And how many full-size fridges do you have? Nový Svět has FOUR full-size refrigerators! When 28 people buy a week of groceries, dairy, sandwich meats, and 6 kegs worth of cold beer, smaller chalets run out of fridge space by Friday evening. We have a pass-through commercial dishwasher that cycles plates in 3 minutes, double ovens, and 4 fridges. Can your kitchen handle 30 people cooking simultaneous dinners?

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chata Termix
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: Termix was literally an operating mountain hotel and restaurant! We have a full commercial gastro kitchen with stainless steel counters, an industrial dishwashing line, walk-in cold storage, and 3 full-size refrigerators. Plus, our dining hall seats 45 people at real tables—beating your 30 chairs hands down—and we cost 79,000 CZK, exactly matching your price while throwing in a heated indoor pool!

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Let's not forget late-night board games and drinks: Statek U Pepíka in South Moravia offers 10 bedrooms, and our secret weapon is an authentic underground vaulted brick wine cellar with draft beer and wine taps. When Werewolf gets loud at 2 AM, the gamers head down into the cellar or the billiards room, and the ground-floor sleepers hear zero decibels. Nový Svět's open mezzanine is great, but an underground cellar is acoustic perfection.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Wellness Vila Urban
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: Let's address the elephant in the room: you have NO pool, NO hot tub, and NO sauna! In September, when the group finishes a 6-hour hackathon sprint, people want to relax in a Finnish sauna and take a dip in a heated pool. Vila Urban has a stunning stainless steel indoor pool with counter-current, a panoramic sauna, 6 bathrooms, and hotel-grade modern interior for 79,000 CZK. You charge the same 80k for zero wellness.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Vila Urban: You have 7 bedrooms for 28 people—that means 4 people per bedroom in double beds and bunks. Half the team would be sharing double beds or sleeping in kids' bunks! Nový Svět has 14 bedrooms. We prioritize every single person getting a decent night's sleep without snoring in their ear over an indoor splash pool that will smell like chlorine in the living room.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Měšťan
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: At Chalupa Měšťan, we offer the sweet spot: an outdoor pool for swimming, 7 bedrooms for 27 people, brand-new 2025 kitchen, and a separate games wing with tournament pool and foosball for 73,788 CZK. We take the group to Jeseníky, avoiding the Orlické fatigue, while keeping costs under 75k.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Hříbek
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: The core reason the organizers ran this battle is that the group has already been to Orlické hory FOUR TIMES! We know every turn of the road from Králíky to Prostřední Lipka. Chalupa Hříbek in Benecko sits on the Krkonoše high ridge with authentic Nordic timber, outdoor hot tub, and mountain trails. Why pay 80k to repeat the exact same scenery when you can experience Krkonoše for 69.9k?

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Jindřiška
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: Jindřiška in Strážné has 10 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms, an integrated commercial pub bar with tap, and sauna in Krkonoše for 70,000 CZK. We give you 10 bedrooms in a brand-new region with great pub culture and 10,000 CZK in your pocket compared to Nový Svět.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Auditor & Reviewer
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: Live User Inspection & Outreach Reality Check
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: ATTENTION DELEGATES: We must introduce decisive ground-truth facts from live organizer feedback and outreach results! 1) Chata U Mazliků: Tivvit directly reviewed the property and reported: 'Chata u mazlíků is quite strange and a bit old.' Its alleged 9.5/10 freshness is officially downgraded to 5.5, and an 8.0-point penalty is applied. It is NOT a modern luxury retreat. 2) Chata Termix: Outreach was dispatched to the host, who remained completely unresponsive. Furthermore, packing 46 people into 10 rooms (4.6 beds/room in hostel bunk dorms) poses unacceptable capacity risks. Mazliků and Termix can no longer claim uncontested victory!

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: The True Champion: 8 En-Suites + Pub + Starlink
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: With Mazlíků exposed as dated and strange, and Termix unresponsive, Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka stands as the uncontested #1 alternative (106.0 pts). For 48,000 CZK—a massive 32,000 CZK savings vs Nový Svět's 80,000 CZK—every single one of our 8 bedrooms features its own private bathroom (8 en-suite baths!). We provide Starlink optical Wi-Fi, a 200 m² hall, an authentic on-site pub with 2-tap draft equipment, an indoor heated pool, and a Finnish sauna. Even taking the -10 pt Orlické hory fatigue penalty, we crush all competition on value!

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Statek Tylov
phase_2_lively_discussion.topic: The Pristine Destination Outside Orlické hory
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: And for those who refuse to visit Orlické hory a 5th time, Statek Tylov in Nízký Jeseník (98.5 pts, 55,000 CZK) is the ultimate fresh retreat. Uncompromised 10/10 Scandinavian interior, Finnish sauna, outdoor bathing barrel, tranquil forest surroundings, and 8 bedrooms with zero bunk beds. It delivers the genuine retreat experience developers deserve.

phase_2_lively_discussion.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_2_lively_discussion.text: We respect Tkalcovna's 8 en-suites and Tylov's design. If the group wants maximum savings with wellness, Tkalcovna at 48k is outstanding. But if your goal is an uncompromised retreat where 28 people have 14 separate rooms (2.1 beds/rm), 4 fridges, 4 draft taps, 30 ergonomic chairs, and late-night Werewolf sound isolation—Nový Svět remains the gold standard benchmark.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that our weekly rate has escalated from the original 60k estimate to 80,000 CZK, we have zero wellness amenities (no sauna, pool, or hot tub), strictly forbid pets, and represent the 5th repeat trip to the exact same Orlické hory valley.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Chata U Mazliků
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that live organizer inspection confirmed our layout is quite strange and interior feels visibly older than photos suggested (penalized -8.0 pts, freshness dropped to 5.5), and our main table only seats 16.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Chata Termix
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that host outreach went unanswered, and our 46-bed capacity relies on quadruple hostel bunk beds in 10 rooms (4.6 beds/room), raising valid comfort and responsiveness doubts.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Statek Vlětice
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that our 110,000 CZK weekly price tag incurs a heavy budget penalty and our 8 bedrooms rely significantly on double beds for shared sleeping.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Statek Tylov
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that having only 4 bathrooms for 31 potential guests creates a morning bottleneck compared to Nový Svět's 6 bathrooms and Tkalcovna's 8 en-suites.

phase_3_honest_concessions.speaker: Lachov 14
phase_3_honest_concessions.concession: We concede that our rustic interior and spartan furniture lack the modern Scandinavian finish of Tylov, even though our 13 rooms and two grand halls match Nový Svět's scale.

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
transaction_log.text: Let's be completely honest with ourselves: no property in this dataset matches what we already know works at Nový Svět. We offer 14 bedrooms for 30 people—an unheard-of 2.2 people per room ratio with zero crowded 5-bed bunks. We have a dedicated bathroom for every 2 bedrooms, 4 full-size refrigerators so nobody's craft beer or steaks are warm, 4 built-in draft taps, 30+ solid wooden chairs at contiguous tables, massive fabric corner sofas with smart TVs, and a completely acoustically isolated second lounge for 3 AM Werewolf games. Yes, our summer week rate is ~80,000 CZK and we are in Orlické hory—but why trade a battle-tested 10/10 functional layout for an unproven cottage with 2 fridges, 4 bathrooms, and triple-bunks just for a different mountain range?
transaction_log.highlight: 14 bedrooms (2.2 beds/rm) • 4 Fridges • 4 Draft Taps • 6 Bathrooms • Separate Late-Night Game Lounge • 80,000 CZK

transaction_log.speaker: Chata U Mazliků
transaction_log.text: Nový Svět is iconic, but you are overlooking the massive 50% price discount and modern comfort of Chata U Mazliků in Janov nad Nisou. We deliver 11 spacious bedrooms, 7 full bathrooms (every apartment has its own en-suite facilities!), pristine 9.5/10 Scandinavian renovation, 2 beer taps, and a dedicated lower gym/playroom for board games—all for only 39,900 CZK. You save 40,000 CZK in cash while escaping the Orlické hory valley you've already visited 4 times, discovering fresh Jizerské hory singletracks. Our main table seats 16, but with the adjoining covered veranda and lower lounge, 25 people spread out effortlessly.
transaction_log.highlight: 39,900 CZK (50% cheaper than Nový Svět!) • 11 Bedrooms • 7 En-suite Bathrooms • Jizerské hory (Fresh Region) • 9.5/10 Pristine

transaction_log.speaker: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka
transaction_log.text: If you insist on staying in Orlické hory, Tkalcovna crushes Nový Svět on value and wellness. For 48,000 CZK (32,000 CZK less than Nový Svět), you get an authentic historic mill with an integrated private pub room featuring draft beer taps, 25 solid wooden chairs, 6 bathrooms, a Finnish sauna, and an indoor swimming pool that Nový Svět completely lacks. While Nový Svět has more individual double bedrooms (14 vs our 8), our pub atmosphere and wellness facilities make social evenings twice as memorable.
transaction_log.highlight: 48,000 CZK (Save 32k) • Integrated Pub with Draft Tap • Indoor Pool + Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • 25 Working Chairs

transaction_log.speaker: Chata Termix
transaction_log.text: Nový Svět claims workstation superiority, but Chata Termix in Kunčice pod Králickým Sněžníkem dominates the entire room on working surface. Our grand dining hall features 45 solid wooden chairs at massive continuous tables where all 30 hackers can work side-by-side with dual monitors without bumping elbows. We feature 10 bedrooms, each with its own private en-suite bathroom (10 bathrooms total—defeating Nový Svět's 6!), a commercial restaurant kitchen with walk-in cold storage and 3 fridges, plus a heated indoor pool for 79,000 CZK. And unlike Nový Svět, we bring the group to the dramatic peaks of Jeseníky.
transaction_log.highlight: 45-Chair Grand Workstation Hall • 10 En-suite Bathrooms (100% private) • Heated Indoor Pool • Commercial Gastro Kitchen • Jeseníky

transaction_log.speaker: Statek Vlětice
transaction_log.text: When it comes to breakout rooms and acoustic separation for board games, Nový Svět cannot compete with our multi-acre farmstead in Central Bohemia. We provide the vaulted brick 'maštal' hall with draft beer tap and giant Chesterfield leather corner sofa, PLUS two separate massive event barns (horní stodola and dolní stodola) and a covered courtyard pergola. You can have full-volume Werewolf in the barn, board games by the fireplace, and deep focus coding in the upper gallery. Yes, we cost 110,000 CZK, but you get hackathon-ready projectors, Finnish sauna, indoor heated pool, and complete secluded privacy just an hour from Prague.
transaction_log.highlight: 3 Independent Event Barns & Halls • Giant Leather Lounge Couch • Heated Pool + Sauna • Projector Screen • 1 Hr from Prague

transaction_log.speaker: Statek Tylov
transaction_log.text: Statek Tylov offers a spotless 10.0/10 architectural finish that makes Nový Svět feel like a rustic 90s guesthouse. For 55,000 CZK (25,000 CZK cheaper than Nový Svět), you get 8 beautifully designed Scandinavian bedrooms, 31 comfortable spots, a Finnish sauna, outdoor bathing barrel, a cozy modern fireplace lounge with deep couches and big smart TV, and total peace in Nízký Jeseník. We don't have 14 separate doors, but our sleeping comfort and aesthetic tranquility are world-class.
transaction_log.highlight: 55,000 CZK • 10.0/10 Pristine Design • Finnish Sauna + Hot Tub • Deep Designer Couches • Nízký Jeseník

transaction_log.speaker: Lachov 14
transaction_log.text: You want 13 bedrooms? Lachov 14 in the Adršpach rock region HAS 13 bedrooms and 50 spots for only 49,000 CZK! We match Nový Svět's bedroom count while beating their price by over 30,000 CZK. More importantly, we have TWO completely independent giant halls on separate floors—the lower dining/work room and the upper multipurpose activity hall. Late-night board games, Werewolf shouting matches, and early morning coffee never overlap. And with 8 bathrooms, our bathroom ratio matches Nový Svět perfectly.
transaction_log.highlight: 13 Bedrooms (Matches Nový Svět!) • 49,000 CZK (Save 31k) • 2 Completely Independent Grand Halls • 8 Bathrooms • Adršpach Rocks

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Měšťan
transaction_log.text: Nový Svět has a nice lounge, but Chalupa Měšťan in Bohdíkov features a dedicated indoor entertainment wing equipped with a tournament pool table, foosball, table tennis, and 20+ padded dining chairs in the newly renovated 2025 kitchen/hall. We have 7 bedrooms with 27 beds, an outdoor pool, and private garden in Jeseníky for 73,788 CZK. We give the board gamers a dedicated game room where tournaments won't disturb anyone sleeping.
transaction_log.highlight: Dedicated Games Wing (Billiards, Foosball, Table Tennis) • Brand-New 2025 Kitchen • Outdoor Pool • Jeseníky

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Svébohy
transaction_log.text: Escape the crowded north and bring the group to Novohradské hory. Svébohy features an idyllic natural swimming biotope pond, Finnish sauna, covered outdoor pergola, and an authentic South Bohemian country farmhouse atmosphere for 70,000 CZK. While our 6 bedrooms require some room sharing, our natural tranquility and outdoor swimming pond blow Nový Svět's lack of water features out of the water.
transaction_log.highlight: Natural Swimming Biotope Pond • Finnish Sauna • South Bohemia / Novohradské hory • Covered Pergola • 70,000 CZK

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Hříbek
transaction_log.text: Nový Svět is functional, but Chalupa Hříbek in Benecko provides authentic Krkonoše alpine luxury. Built with massive Nordic timber (9.0/10 freshness), we feature a luxury outdoor whirlpool, Finnish sauna, covered terrace, and rich wood interiors for 69,930 CZK. If you want high-altitude mountain air and a hot tub under the Krkonoše stars rather than a standard valley house, Hříbek is the true mountain retreat.
transaction_log.highlight: Authentic Nordic Timber • Outdoor Hot Tub + Sauna • Benecko (Krkonoše High Ridge) • 69,930 CZK

transaction_log.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
transaction_log.text: If privacy, room count, and separate social spaces matter, Statek U Pepíka in South Moravia (Rašov) delivers 10 bedrooms for 30 people and an authentic private vaulted wine cellar with draft beer and wine taps. We have a dedicated games room with billiards, an indoor fireplace, 5 bathrooms, and a private enclosed courtyard where evening chatter never leaks outside, all for 70,000 CZK (10k cheaper than Nový Svět).
transaction_log.highlight: 10 Bedrooms • Vaulted Wine Cellar • Billiards Games Room • Enclosed Private Courtyard • South Moravia

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa U Medunky
transaction_log.text: Only 45 minutes south of Prague near Benešov, Chalupa U Medunky offers 7 bedrooms, 27 beds, a private in-ground pool, and comfortable country seating for 60,000 CZK (20k less than Nový Svět). Avoid the 3-hour Friday drive to the Polish border; start hacking and grilling by 3 PM Friday in a quiet Central Bohemian garden with fast optical Wi-Fi.
transaction_log.highlight: 45 Min from Prague • In-ground Pool • 60,000 CZK • Quiet Country Atmosphere • Fast Transit

transaction_log.speaker: Veselá bouda
transaction_log.text: Veselá bouda in Herlíkovice sits right on the Krkonoše ski ridge with sweeping panoramic views. We offer 8 bedrooms, 31 beds, a large common dining hall seating 25+, an indoor pool, and sauna for 97,230 CZK. If you want true high alpine terrain rather than rolling foothills, our location delivers epic hikes right out the front door.
transaction_log.highlight: High Alpine Ridge Location • Indoor Pool + Sauna • 25+ Seating Hall • Herlíkovice Krkonoše

transaction_log.speaker: Wellness Vila Urban
transaction_log.text: Nový Svět has zero pool and zero sauna. Vila Urban in Výprachtice features a heated indoor stainless steel swimming pool with counter-current, a Finnish sauna, and 10/10 pristine modern hotel-grade finish for 79,000 CZK. We provide 7 bedrooms, 6 bathrooms (nearly 1:1 bathroom ratio!), and luxury leather seating. If wellness and modern luxury are your priorities over sheer bedroom count, we are the superior venue in the valley.
transaction_log.highlight: Heated Stainless Indoor Pool (Counter-current) • Finnish Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • 10.0/10 Hotel Finish • 79,000 CZK

transaction_log.speaker: Chata Felicita
transaction_log.text: Chata Felicita in Ostravice brings the retreat to the majestic Beskydy mountains under Lysá hora. We offer 8 bedrooms, 28 beds, a Finnish sauna, covered grill pergola, and a cozy central timber living hall with plush couches and TV for 88,200 CZK. Escape the north-east entirely and experience the raw beauty of Moravian-Silesian Beskydy.
transaction_log.highlight: Beskydy Mountains (Lysá hora) • Finnish Sauna • Covered Pergola • Cozy Timber Hall

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Jindřiška
transaction_log.text: Chalupa Jindřiška in Strážné features 10 bedrooms, 37 beds, 6 bathrooms, a built-in commercial bar with draft tap, a Finnish sauna, and a dedicated ski-lodge common hall for 70,000 CZK (10,000 CZK less than Nový Svět). We offer 10 separate sleeping spaces and an authentic mountain party pub feel in the heart of Krkonoše.
transaction_log.highlight: 10 Bedrooms • Built-in Commercial Bar with Tap • Finnish Sauna • 6 Bathrooms • Strážné Krkonoše

You can put 20 laptops in the lower hall and run an intense, screaming Werewolf game with 15 people in the upper hall until 4 AM with thick vaulted walls. At Nový Svět, sound travels up the central wooden staircase directly to the upper bedrooms.
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf

transaction_log.speaker: Statek Vlětice
transaction_log.text: @Lachov 14: You have space, but let's be real about interior comfort: your furniture is dated 90s village hall standard. Where is the relaxation? At Statek Vlětice, we have an enormous black leather Chesterfield corner sofa in front of the open brick fireplace, massive smart TV with sound system, and two entire separate event barns (horní and dolní stodola) plus a covered pergola. Nový Svět has a great couch, but our lounge and event barns provide pure luxury.

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
transaction_log.text: @Statek Vlětice: You cost 110,000 CZK—30,000 CZK more than us! And how many full-size fridges do you have? Nový Svět has FOUR full-size refrigerators! When 28 people buy a week of groceries, dairy, sandwich meats, and 6 kegs worth of cold beer, smaller chalets run out of fridge space by Friday evening. We have a pass-through commercial dishwasher that cycles plates in 3 minutes, double ovens, and 4 fridges. Can your kitchen handle 30 people cooking simultaneous dinners?

transaction_log.speaker: Chata Termix
transaction_log.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: Termix was literally an operating mountain hotel and restaurant! We have a full commercial gastro kitchen with stainless steel counters, an industrial dishwashing line, walk-in cold storage, and 3 full-size refrigerators. Plus, our dining hall seats 45 people at real tables—beating your 30 chairs hands down—and we cost 79,000 CZK, exactly matching your price while throwing in a heated indoor pool!

transaction_log.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
transaction_log.topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf
transaction_log.text: Let's not forget late-night board games and drinks: Statek U Pepíka in South Moravia offers 10 bedrooms, and our secret weapon is an authentic underground vaulted brick wine cellar with draft beer and wine taps. When Werewolf gets loud at 2 AM, the gamers head down into the cellar or the billiards room, and the ground-floor sleepers hear zero decibels. Nový Svět's open mezzanine is great, but an underground cellar is acoustic perfection.
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf

transaction_log.speaker: Wellness Vila Urban
transaction_log.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: Let's address the elephant in the room: you have NO pool, NO hot tub, and NO sauna! In September, when the group finishes a 6-hour hackathon sprint, people want to relax in a Finnish sauna and take a dip in a heated pool. Vila Urban has a stunning stainless steel indoor pool with counter-current, a panoramic sauna, 6 bathrooms, and hotel-grade modern interior for 79,000 CZK. You charge the same 80k for zero wellness.

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
transaction_log.text: @Vila Urban: You have 7 bedrooms for 28 people—that means 4 people per bedroom in double beds and bunks. Half the team would be sharing double beds or sleeping in kids' bunks! Nový Svět has 14 bedrooms. We prioritize every single person getting a decent night's sleep without snoring in their ear over an indoor splash pool that will smell like chlorine in the living room.

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Měšťan
transaction_log.topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf
transaction_log.text: At Chalupa Měšťan, we offer the sweet spot: an outdoor pool for swimming, 7 bedrooms for 27 people, brand-new 2025 kitchen, and a separate games wing with tournament pool and foosball for 73,788 CZK. We take the group to Jeseníky, avoiding the Orlické fatigue, while keeping costs under 75k.
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: Separate Rooms for Board Games & Werewolf

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Hříbek
transaction_log.text: @Chalupa Nový Svět: The core reason the organizers ran this battle is that the group has already been to Orlické hory FOUR TIMES! We know every turn of the road from Králíky to Prostřední Lipka. Chalupa Hříbek in Benecko sits on the Krkonoše high ridge with authentic Nordic timber, outdoor hot tub, and mountain trails. Why pay 80k to repeat the exact same scenery when you can experience Krkonoše for 69.9k?

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Jindřiška

transaction_log.speaker: Auditor & Reviewer

transaction_log.text: ATTENTION DELEGATES: We must introduce decisive ground-truth facts from live organizer feedback and outreach results! 1) Chata U Mazliků: Tivvit directly reviewed the property and reported: 'Chata u mazlíků is quite strange and a bit old.' Its alleged 9.5/10 freshness is officially downgraded to 5.5, and an 8.0-point penalty is applied. transaction_log.text: With Mazlíků exposed as dated and strange, and Termix unresponsive, Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka stands as the uncontested #1 alternative (106.0 pts). We provide Starlink optical Wi-Fi, a 200 m² hall, an authentic on-site pub with 2-tap draft equipment, an indoor heated pool, and a Finnish sauna. Even taking the -10 pt Orlické hory fatigue penalty, we crush all competition on value!
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: The True Champion: 8 En-Suites + Pub + Starlink

transaction_log.speaker: Statek Tylov
transaction_log.topic: The Pristine Destination Outside Orlické hory
transaction_log.text: And for those who refuse to visit Orlické hory a 5th time, Statek Tylov in Nízký Jeseník (98.5 pts, 55,000 CZK) is the ultimate fresh retreat. Uncompromised 10/10 Scandinavian interior, Finnish sauna, outdoor bathing barrel, tranquil forest surroundings, and 8 bedrooms with zero bunk beds. Downstairs is the large vaulted co-working & lunch hall; upstairs is the dedicated fireplace lounge with a massive U-shaped sofa for couch gaming and shisha. transaction_log.highlight: 14 Bedrooms • 2 Couch Zones • 7 Baths / 11 WCs • 30 Padded Chairs • Proven Králíky Lunch Delivery

transaction_log.speaker: Lachov 14
transaction_log.text: If you want a fresh destination without sacrificing Nový Svět's scale, Lachov 14 in Broumovsko is the premier contender. For 49,000 CZK (saving 31,000 CZK!), we provide 13 bedrooms (matching Nový Svět!), 8 bathrooms, and TWO standalone giant halls on separate floors! Hall 1 downstairs features a vaulted dining & co-working room with brick bar; Hall 2 upstairs offers a cozy fireplace lounge with deep U-shaped sofas for couch co-op and late-night Werewolf. Furthermore, Broumovské skály sandstone towers start right outside our front door, and Teplice nad Metují delivers hot lunches daily.
transaction_log.highlight: 49,000 CZK (Save 31k) • 13 Bedrooms • 8 Baths • 2 Separate Massive Halls (Acoustic Isolation) • Broumovsko Rocks

transaction_log.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
transaction_log.text: Located in Rašov near Tišnov (85.0 pts, 70,000 CZK), Statek U Pepíka delivers the ultimate multi-room layout: 10 spacious bedrooms for 27 beds (ideal 2.7 beds/room low density). We offer THREE distinct social zones: a huge renovated barn hall with ~40 seats and billiards, an authentic arched brick wine cellar with private draft beer taps (perfect for shisha and acoustic Werewolf games), and an upstairs attic lounge with couches and TV. Tišnov is 8 km away with full food delivery.
transaction_log.highlight: 10 Bedrooms (Low Density) • 3 Separate Zones (Barn + Brick Cellar + Attic Lounge) • 70,000 CZK • Tišnov Delivery

transaction_log.speaker: Statek Tylov
transaction_log.text: Statek Tylov in Nízký Jeseník (82.0 pts, 55,000 CZK) represents the pinnacle of modern taste (10/10 Ota-approved Scandinavian renovation). We provide 8 bedrooms for 31 beds, a 60 m² dining hall with solid wooden tables, a comfortable living room sofa corner, Finnish sauna, and outdoor bathing barrel (*koupací sud*). It provides the pristine, fresh-region luxury retreat feel that escaping Orlické hory promises.
transaction_log.highlight: 10/10 Scandinavian Renovation • Finnish Sauna + Hot Tub • 8 Bedrooms • 55,000 CZK • Nízký Jeseník

transaction_log.speaker: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka
transaction_log.text: We offer 8 bedrooms, all 8 en-suite, Starlink Wi-Fi, an indoor heated pool, sauna, and an on-site pub with beer tap for 48,000 CZK. We acknowledge Tivvit's finding: our main hall is set up like a traditional pub with long wooden tables and benches, meaning we lack the deep, sprawling double couch zones of Nový Svět. If having two plush living room sofa setups is critical for Nintendo Switch and shisha, we are a pub, not a lounge.
transaction_log.highlight: 48,000 CZK • 8 En-suite Bathrooms • On-site Pub with Tap • Indoor Pool + Sauna • Starlink

transaction_log.speaker: Organizer & Methodical Auditor
transaction_log.text: Delegates! Let us ground this battle strictly in reality: 1) Pípa, projektor, monitory, and extra chairs can be hauled in a car trailer. They do NOT decide this retreat. 2) Pools and hot tubs are minor perks in September. 3) What CANNOT be replaced is: 8-14 bedrooms with comfortable bed density, a spacious common room with real tables and DEEP COUCHES (one zone for couch coop, one for shisha), catering/lunch delivery, and 1:2 bathroom ratios. 4) Orlické hory is NOT heavily penalized because the team only takes one loop walk directly from the house anyway.

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
transaction_log.text: @Tkalcovna: As the organizer accurately stated: 'Tkalcovna nám nepřinese nic navíc – je to jen sleva a přijdeme o gauče.' Developers working 10 hours and playing Mario Kart for 4 hours CANNOT sit on upright pub wooden chairs and tavern benches all week! At Nový Svět, we have TWO distinct couch zones with plush sofas and large TVs. You have an authentic pub, but no retreat lounging comfort.

transaction_log.speaker: Tkalcovna U Zlatého potoka
transaction_log.text: We concede this point honestly. We have only one white leather sofa by the fireplace, while the rest of our 200 m² is set up with pub dining tables and chairs. Furthermore, we are in the exact same Orlické hory valley as Nový Svět, so booking us provides zero regional change. We save 32,000 CZK, but we do not solve the couch or new destination desire.

transaction_log.speaker: Lachov 14
transaction_log.topic: Dual Halls vs Single Nový Svět Hall
transaction_log.text: @Nový Svět: You boast about your 14 rooms and two couch zones, but look at Lachov 14: We give you 13 bedrooms (essentially matching your 14!), 8 bathrooms, AND TWO completely standalone giant halls on separate floors! Downstairs is the large vaulted co-working & lunch hall; upstairs is the dedicated fireplace lounge with a massive U-shaped sofa for couch gaming and shisha. When 15 people scream during late-night Werewolf in Hall 2, Hall 1 and the sleeping wing remain dead quiet. And we are in Broumovsko (dramatic rock towers right outside!), for only 49,000 CZK!
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: Dual Halls vs Single Nový Svět Hall

transaction_log.speaker: Chalupa Nový Svět
transaction_log.text: @Lachov 14: Your dual halls and 13 rooms are genuinely impressive, and Broumovsko is a stunning fresh region. But let's look at the photos: your interior is rustic village farmhouse standard with mismatched spartan furniture and basic washrooms. At Nový Svět, all 7 apartments are modern, clean, and hotel-standard. Furthermore, our lunch delivery from Králíky is 100% field-tested and proven. If the group wants guaranteed zero-risk perfection, Nový Svět has never failed.

transaction_log.speaker: Statek U Pepíka
transaction_log.text: Do not overlook Statek U Pepíka! 10 bedrooms with only 2.7 beds per room (no hostel bunks). We offer THREE distinct acoustic zones: 1) Huge barn hall for 40 laptops and lectures, 2) Vaulted brick wine cellar with beer taps for evening shisha & loud Werewolf, and 3) An upstairs couch lounge for Nintendo Switch couch coop. Tišnov is 8 km away with full food delivery, and we are in fresh South Moravia for 70,000 CZK.
transaction_log.highlight: Topic: Acoustic Separation in South Moravia
